title: State Transition Boundaries
summary: Check transitions across process boundaries, partial saves, and restart recovery before trusting terminal states.

title: Inter-Lock Races
summary: Inspect operations split across async awaits or separate locks where stale snapshots can overwrite newer mutations.

title: Producer vs Consumer Schema Drift
summary: Verify that serialized records match reader assumptions on missing fields, null values, and malformed siblings.

title: Unbounded Buffers & File Descriptors
summary: Look for unthrottled output accumulation, leaked child file descriptors, and missing disk/memory caps.

title: Orphaned Background Descendants
summary: Verify whether cancelling a direct child leaves sub-processes, worker threads, or containers running.

title: Falsifying Positive Claims
summary: Always design a minimal negative control to distinguish real findings from coincidental errors or environment noise.
